review:
Klowns is a horror-carnival slot on a 6-reel, 5-row grid with drop cascades and all-scatter wins, hosted by Lester and Jester. Hacksaw states a 10,000x max win, reachable in every game mode.

All wins in a round are collected in a Total Win Bar, and any activated Klown Multipliers are applied to that total at the end of the spin. Needle Boxes clear symbols once the grid settles: low-symbol boxes remove every low-paying symbol and pay 0.1x the bet for each, and high-symbol boxes do the same for premiums. Hacksaw doesn't publish RTP or volatility for this game outside the game itself.
